headline: Mooring County Turns Colonial; Weathered Expanse Works Shift Again
war_summary: Two fronts have turned since this office's last edition. Mooring County, reported at six Warden works to five, now reads six Colonial to five with one ruin unclaimed, and it remains the busiest district of the hour: ten actions in the past two hours, eighteen in six, with daily casualties above seventeen thousand on either side. Weathered Expanse has shifted again, the Colonials raising a fourth work as the Wardens fall to two and a third lies unclaimed; nine actions in six hours there, four in the last two. Callum's Cape, the day's most active field at thirty-five actions, has gone quiet across the past six hours, though its lines still stand four Colonial works to three Warden and its daily toll exceeds sixteen thousand per side. Marban Hollow holds three apiece with two unclaimed and no fresh action. Linn Mercy shows ten Colonial works and one ruin, four actions in six hours but none in two. Stonecradle, Lykos Isle, Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf have seen scattered captures and neutralizations; the remaining provinces report no ownership changes.
